page.layout: One printed page of running text, with a column of verse numbers (20, 21, 22, 23) in the right margin. A strip of the neighbouring page shows at the left edge and is not transcribed. Running head at top, page number at top right, signature at foot.

main_text.p: quod ante quartum annum licitum non erat. Nam tribus primis annis incircumcisa adhuc & profana fuit vinea, ut fructus illius colligere, aut comedere non liceret. Anno quarto omnis illius fructus, in signum gratiarum actionis, sanctificabatur, vel offerebatur Deo, & anno demum quinto illius fructus communes fiebant, vel ad communem vitæ usum adhibebantur, ex lege Levit.19.v.23.& seqq.)è militia domum revertitor & abito, ne forte moriatur, & alius dedicet domum ipsius, aut alius vineam ipsius communem faciat, Duet.20.v.5.
20Qui despondit mulierem, & nō accepit eā, abito & revertitor domum suam, ne forte moriatur in prælio, & aliquis alius accipiat eam, Deut.20.v.7.
21Vir timidus & imbellis similiter è militia in domum suam revertitor, ne cor fratrū ejus, sicut cor illius, dissolvatur, v.8.
22A filio viginti annorum, & suprà, numerato egredientem ad bellum, per capita eorū, & domos patrū suorum, Num.1.v.3. Num.26.v.2.

p.i: Si, potestate ejus rei datâ, exercitus aut milites per terminum fratrum suorum transeunt, non irritanto eos, sed cibum emunto ab eis argento, & comedunto: aquam emunto ab eis argento, & bibunto: neque transeunto per agros aut vineas: neque declinanto ad dexteram vel finistram, sed regiâ viâ gradiuntor, donec ter-

page.notes: The page is printed in roman and italic; italic runs are marked. The "è" after the closing bracket of "seqq.)" in the first paragraph appears as printed but is doubtful. The page number "391" is set in an old form and is read with some uncertainty. The verse numbers in the right margin are bare numerals and are transcribed as notes. The left edge shows the neighbouring page, which is not transcribed.
